integrity: The proof independently derives the rank-one image-kernel type decomposition and adjacency relation, translates forcing into a bipartite edge-elimination rule, proves a forest obstruction and excludes the spanning-tree extremal case, then gives an explicit sharp forcing profile. Direct matrix multiplication over three prime fields and exhaustive small type-profile checks corroborate the symbolic proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the underlying simple graph of the standard directed zero-divisor graph of two-by-two full matrix rings over finite fields.
The full zero forcing polynomial and a closed count of minimum zero forcing sets are not determined.
No minimum-rank or maximum-nullity equality is asserted.
title: Zero forcing in two-by-two finite-field matrix zero-divisor graphs
